title: Device lifecycle notifications
summary: Notifies device owners and administrators about Entra registration, Intune enrollment, and compliance transitions through Teams or scoped email.
highlights: Guides administrators through readiness-gated setup and protected delivery testing before collection.
Routes each event independently to device owners, administrators, or both.
Uses managed identity and mailbox-scoped Exchange Application RBAC without destructive device permissions.
Stores delivery history and overlapping poll state for resilient lifecycle detection.
